summary: Perion Network Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 8, 2026, announcing a new partnership with Acrossmedia241 to expand its Outmax AI agent into Greece and the CEE region. The press release details a commercial distribution agreement, not a corporate transaction. No financial terms, ownership changes, board actions, or binding commitments are disclosed. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer regarding a business development. Thus, it does not meet the criteria for a special-situations category.
